file_roles.evidence: Diff changes the check to `!testingSnapshotBehaviorInIsolation && !replCoord->isV1ElectionProtocol()` so the protocol-v0 rejection no longer applies in the isolated snapshot test mode.

rationale: The test fails because its readConcern majority operations are rejected in Command::run for protocol version 0 even in testing-in-isolation mode. The fix corrects that condition in the same function. The reporter guessed a different cause (killing blocked ops), which the diff does not support.
notes: Symptom is in a JS test not in the packet; the link between assert.soon failure and the rejected command is inferred.
